primary_claim: Most published multimodal and text membership inference attack (MIA) benchmarks are broken because a target-model-free classifier using only dataset features achieves near-100% AUC on most of them (e.g. ~98.6% AUC on VL-MIA-Flickr-2k), showing these benchmarks measure distribution shift rather than memorization, and the Hutchinson-Hessian-trace theory claimed to explain perturbation-based MIA success (DetectGPT, Min-K%++) empirically fails.

effect.metric: model-free (no model access) baseline AUC on VL-MIA-Flickr-2k

contradicts_or_qualifies: Contradicts the theoretical claim in DetectGPT and Min-K%++ that perturbation-based MIA success is explained by Hutchinson-like Hessian-trace estimation at positive-definite local minima -- empirically the input-space Hessian is not positive-semi-definite even for training samples and Hutchinson-based detection is near chance (AUC≈50%)
Extends Das et al. (2024)'s finding of distribution-shift confounds in MIA benchmarks to the multimodal setting
stated_future_work: What formal geometry captures 'membership-associated loss peaks' if not Hessians?
Does the Hessian-trace failure also hold for diffusion language models, where score matching directly optimizes local Hessian geometry?
Can MIAs be designed that account for true memorization only, e.g. by explicitly modeling domain shift and subtracting it out?
How to best package these baseline tools for integration into safety evaluation frameworks like Inspect AI?
Testing whether model-specific adversarial augmentations yield the strongest membership signals
limitations_stated: Of the benchmarks tested, only the results on LAION-MI are trustworthy (not confounded by distribution shift)
The underlying reason semantic perturbation attacks succeed remains unexplained; no formal analysis available
The nature of 'semantic perturbations' as a discrete-manifold jump (not a local Taylor-expandable move) is not yet well understood
quote: a model-free baseline hits AUC ≈98.6% on VL-MIA-Flickr-2k, meaning “members” and “non-members” are trivially separable.
